metadata.title: Universal Races and Created Peoples
metadata.purpose: Canonical race categories, parent races, bloodlines, lineages, and subtypes with each description stored once.

priority_rule: Race data is authoritative. Pantheon data is secondary and is used only to identify each creator deity, pantheon order, and creator-category name.

canon_authority.authority_rule: The canonical 22-god order and dedicated creator compendium govern every deity-to-people relationship; province and settlement placement does not alter divine parentage or race canon.

character_identity_rule.principle: Ancestry never dictates morality, class, deity loyalty, culture, gender, profession, or chosen future.

humans_near_humans_and_mixed_heritage.family_description: Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage contains the canonical parent races Human, Half-Elf (choose an Elven-Type), Half-Orc (Human + Orc ancestry), Khoravar Half-Elf (choose an Elven-Type), and Umbral Human. All of these ancestries remain under Nebyrr's single creator category.
